services.title: What we do
services.subtitle: Four services, tailored to individual owners and residents.

departments.title: Property Management
departments.description: We manage your property for you: tenants, rent, accounting, bills, maintenance and all the administration that comes with owning it.

detail.intro: Property Management is not just paperwork. SETABASE becomes your trusted local partner and looks after the property as a whole: the accounts, the invoices, the contractors, the legal side and whatever comes up inside the home — whether you live in it or someone else does.

groups.title: You live in your property
groups.lead: You own and enjoy your property. We take care of the management around it.
items: Managing issues with elevators, electricity and utilities

groups.title: You rent out your property
groups.lead: For owners and investors with an apartment, house, compound unit or investment property to let: the full management package.
items: Annual reporting of property costs and expenses
Support with administrative and legal matters

detail.closing: Whether you live in it or rent it out, SETABASE looks after your property as if it were our own.

departments.title: Facility Management
departments.description: Security, cleaning, maintenance and the day-to-day running of your home or building, handled by our team.
departments.note: Currently serving the New Cairo region and Hurghada (Red Sea region), with expansion into other Egyptian cities.

detail.intro: It goes beyond the common areas. Facility Management can reach into the villa, the apartment or the office itself, and take the small everyday things off your plate too.

departments.title: Relocation
departments.description: Home finding, viewings, temporary accommodation and settling-in support for individuals, students, families and retirees moving to Egypt.

detail.intro: Relocating to another country is a big, personal decision. You may be leaving home, moving your family and starting again in a place you don't yet know. We understand how significant this move is — and we will personally guide you through every step.

steps.title: It starts with a conversation
steps.text: A no-obligation phone or video call to get to know you and what you actually need.

steps.title: Before moving
steps.text: The district, the home, and school or work for the rest of the family.

steps.title: Moving
steps.text: Door to door, with three moving offers to compare.

steps.title: Settling in
steps.text: The contract signed, the utilities on and the home furnished.

detail.pricing: Every move is quoted on its own — once we understand yours, we come back quickly with a personalised offer. The first conversation commits you to nothing.
detail.closing: We're not selling a package — we're becoming your trusted partner on the ground.

departments.note: Through Palmayya, our real estate sales company.

explainer.title: Property vs Facility Management — what's the difference?
explainer.intro: People often mix them up, but they answer two different needs. Take a pipe leaking in an apartment:

columns.title: Property Management
columns.summary: Takes care of the money and the contracts of a property — it protects the owner's value and income.
columns.example: The property manager reports the leak, informs the owner and follows the case.

columns.title: Facility Management
columns.summary: Takes care of how the building actually works — it keeps it safe, clean and running.
columns.example: The facility manager sends the plumber and checks that the repair is done properly.

explainer.closing: One team, one point of contact.

opening.title: A move to Egypt, with a partner on the ground.
opening.paragraph: Relocating to another country is a big, personal decision. You may be leaving home, moving your family and starting a new job in a place you don't yet know. We understand how significant this move is — and we will personally guide you through every step.
facts: One point of contact, from the first call to the last box

conversation.title: It starts with a conversation.
conversation.summary: We begin with a phone or video call to get to know you, understand your situation and identify what you actually need.
questions: Who is relocating — an individual, a couple or a family?
What kind of home and lifestyle are you looking for?
Do you need schools or childcare?
What support will you need before and after arrival?
What are your biggest concerns about the move?
conversation.noObligation: Your first conversation with us is simply an opportunity to get to know each other, understand your needs and discuss how we can support your move. There is no obligation to book a service.

next.title: What happens next
next.text: Only once we understand your needs do we propose the right services, next steps and a personalised offer. We're not selling a package — we're becoming your trusted partner on the ground.

relocation.exclusions: We don't ship pets or cars — the regulations and taxes make it impractical.

steps.text: Deliveries, coaches and events on schedule, with one point of contact.

terms: Start with a one-month trial, then a six-month minimum.
Contracts run 6 months, or 1, 2, 3 or 5 years.
Cancel a yearly contract with three months' notice.
Take two or more packages and save 10%.
Bigger teams pay less: 10% off from 50 employees, 12.5% from 100, 15% from 200, 20% from 500.
